periods.summary: Moroboshi is introduced as the local Osaka hero and reigning Seven Stars champion. At the banquet he stops Ikki and Tatara's conflict, displays his flawless spear range, and later invites Ikki to his family restaurant so Ikki will fight him at full strength. His backstory reveals that he lost his legs in a train accident, underwent Kiriko Yakushi's brutal reconstruction and rehabilitation, and returned to battle partly because his sister Koume blamed herself and lost her voice. In the first round he outmaneuvers Ikki with Sanrensei, Hahakiboshi and the improved Tiger Bite capable of damaging Devices. After Ikki awakens Edelweiss-derived movement, Moroboshi endures overwhelming damage, hears Koume cheer again, and nearly wins with a final thrown Tiger King. Ikki sees through him and wins; Moroboshi asks Ikki not to lose before collapsing.

key_events.summary: Treats Ikki at his family restaurant to ensure a worthy duel.
His accident, reconstruction and motive are revealed.
Uses layered tactics but loses after Ikki's final Shinkirou counter.

periods.summary: Although eliminated by Ikki, Moroboshi remains cheerful around the bathhouse and preparation rooms. He rescues Ikki from an awkward moment with Byakuya's overzealous body study by kicking Byakuya away and explaining the misunderstanding. Before Byakuya's match with Ikki, Moroboshi teases him about facing Sara afterward but also warns that Ikki's techniques are too variable to be fully predicted. Byakuya dismisses the warning because he believes Ikki cannot spend Ittou Shura before Sara, setting up Ikki's immediate contradiction of that assumption.
